pass_a_gloss: Qoheleth on death desired; Eleazar's noble example for the young.
pass_b_english: 'Better are the dead than the living,' (Ecclesiastes 4:2) says Qoheleth — that we may not fear death but desire it when the confession calls. Eleazar the aged scribe would not even pretend to eat swine's flesh: spitting it out, he went willingly to the rack, 'leaving the young a noble example, willingly and manfully to die a good death for the revered and holy laws.' (2 Maccabees 6:18–31) So we too, refusing base compliance, shall leave children and brethren an example worth more than life.
